請用 Bilibili App 掃描 QR Code: Scan the QR code with the Bilibili app
已掃描，請在手機上確認登入: Scanned. Confirm the login on your phone
QR Code 已過期，請重新產生: QR code expired. Please generate a new one

找不到 ffmpeg：請到「工具 / 設定」下載 ffmpeg。: ffmpeg not found: download it in "Tools / Settings".
YouTube 要求驗證：請到「帳號 / Cookie」設定 YouTube 的: YouTube asks you to verify: set up YouTube cookies in "Accounts / Cookies" (Firefox or cookies.txt recommended).
瀏覽器開著時無法讀取 Cookie：請完全關閉該瀏覽器，或改用 Firefox: Can't read cookies while the browser is open: fully close that browser, or use Firefox / cookies.txt instead.
無法解密 Chrome / Edge 的 Cookie：請改用 Firefox，: Can't decrypt Chrome / Edge cookies: use Firefox instead, or export a cookies.txt.
Bilibili CDN 擋下了未分段的請求，新版已自動分段下載，按「重試」即可: Bilibili's CDN blocked a non-chunked request. Downloads are now chunked automatically; just click "Retry".
下載中途被 CDN 節點斷線（B站常見於 mirrorcosov 節點）。新版已: The CDN node cut the connection mid-download (common with Bilibili's mirrorcosov node). The app now switches to a more stable backup node and retries harder, so just click "Retry". If it still fails, pick another node manually in "Tools / Settings › Bilibili CDN node".
網路無法到達：通常是連到 IPv6 位址但這台電腦沒有 IPv6。新版已讓 ar: Network unreachable: usually an IPv6 address on a PC without IPv6. aria2c now uses IPv4 only; just click "Retry".
多線下載（aria2c）失敗。若重試仍失敗，可到「工具 / 設定 › 多線下載」: Multi-connection download (aria2c) failed. If retrying doesn't help, untick this site in "Tools / Settings › Multi-connection download" to go back to a normal download.
影片已下載，但轉換成選擇的影片格式時失敗（例如 H.264 不能放進 webm）: The video was downloaded, but converting it to the chosen format failed (e.g. H.264 can't go into webm). Incompatible codecs are now saved as mkv automatically; click "Retry", or change the video format to mkv / mp4.
Bilibili 風控（412）：稍等幾分鐘再試，或重新掃碼登入。: Bilibili rate limit (412): wait a few minutes and try again, or log in again with the QR code.
YouTube 需要 JavaScript 執行環境：請到「工具 / 設定」下載: YouTube needs a JavaScript runtime: download Deno in "Tools / Settings" and update yt-dlp.
指定的畫質 / 格式不存在：請重新「解析格式」選擇，或把畫質改成「最佳畫質」。: The selected quality / format doesn't exist: click "Analyze" again, or set the quality to "Best quality".
此內容需要會員權限，請確認登入的帳號有對應會員。: This content requires a membership. Make sure the logged-in account has it.
yt-dlp 不支援這個網址，請確認網址是否正確，或更新 yt-dlp。: yt-dlp doesn't support this URL. Check the URL, or update yt-dlp.
可用瀏覽器擴充功能「Get cookies.txt LOCALLY」匯出。: Export it with the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" browser extension.
貼上網址後按「解析格式」，可以預覽影片資訊並挑選串流。: Paste a URL and click "Analyze" to preview the video and pick streams.
放進以影片標題命名的資料夾: Put them in a folder named after the video
影片裡的音軌要挑哪一條（直接取網站提供的音軌，不重新壓縮）。: Which audio track to take from the video (uses the site's track as-is, no re-encoding).
佇列是空的。到「下載」頁貼上網址並按「加入佇列」。: The queue is empty. Paste URLs on the "Download" page and click "Add to queue".
yt-dlp -N：同時下載幾個片段。只對 HLS / DASH 分段串流有效。: yt-dlp -N: how many fragments to download at once. Only affects HLS / DASH fragmented streams.
B站影片下載中途斷線（bytes read / more expected /: If Bilibili downloads keep getting cut off (bytes read / more expected / Read timed out), try another CDN node.
同一個檔案同時開幾條連線（aria2c -x / -s，最多 16）。: How many connections per file (aria2c -x / -s, max 16).
關閉視窗時縮到系統匣（而不是結束程式）: Minimize to the system tray when closing the window (instead of exiting)
下載完成 / 失敗時顯示系統通知: Show a notification when downloads finish / fail
啟動時自動檢查 yt-dlp / aria2c 新版: Check for yt-dlp / aria2c updates on startup
最多自動重試幾次（間隔會越拉越長：10 秒、20 秒、40 秒…）。: Maximum automatic retries (the wait grows each time: 10 s, 20 s, 40 s…).
MP3：相容性最好。網站音源本身是有損的，選 320 kbps 或 VBR 0: MP3: most compatible. Online audio is lossy to begin with, so 320 kbps or VBR 0 is plenty.
FLAC：無損格式，但網站來源（AAC / Opus）本身已是有損，轉 FLAC: FLAC: lossless, but the source (AAC / Opus) is already lossy, so FLAC won't improve quality; it only avoids another lossy encode. Files get much larger.
M4A：若來源就是 AAC 會直接取出，不重新壓縮。: M4A: if the source is AAC, it's extracted as-is without re-encoding.
Opus：YouTube 的最高音質來源通常就是 Opus。: Opus: YouTube's best audio source is usually Opus.
WAV：未壓縮，檔案最大，無法嵌入封面。: WAV: uncompressed, largest files, can't embed a thumbnail.
原始音訊：直接取出網站提供的最佳音軌，完全不轉檔。: Original audio: extracts the site's best audio track with no conversion at all.
請用 Bilibili App 掃描 QR Code（約 3 分鐘內有效）。: Scan the QR code with the Bilibili app (valid for about 3 minutes).
找不到 yt-dlp.exe，要現在從 GitHub 下載嗎？: yt-dlp.exe not found. Download it from GitHub now?
目前設定會執行的指令（複製到 BAT 使用時，% 要改成 %%）：: The command your current settings will run (when copying into a BAT file, change % to %%):
確定要清除所有歷史紀錄？這個動作無法復原。: Clear all history? This can't be undone.
匯入會覆蓋目前的設定與 B站登入資料，確定要繼續？: Importing will overwrite your current settings and Bilibili login. Continue?
用手機 Bilibili App 掃描左邊的 QR Code。登入資料只存在這台: Scan the QR code on the left with the Bilibili mobile app. Login data stays on this PC only.
Firefox 可以在開著的狀態下直接讀取，最穩定。: Firefox can be read while it's open; most reliable.
Google 不允許第三方程式用帳號密碼登入。: Google doesn't allow third-party apps to log in with a username and password.
影片網址（一行一個，可一次貼多個）: Video URLs (one per line, you can paste several)
勾選要下載的集數後按上方「加入佇列」，每一集會分別加入佇列；上面的下載選項（畫質: Tick the episodes you want and click "Add to queue" above. Each episode is queued separately, and the download options above (quality, format, audio…) apply to every episode.
串流清單（解析後列出所有影片 / 音訊編碼，點一列可指定下載那個串流）: Streams (after analyzing, lists every video / audio encoding; click a row to download that exact stream)
下載時依網址自動判斷網站，套用對應的登入方式。帳號資料只存在這台電腦。: The site is detected from each URL and the matching login is used. Account data stays on this PC only.
「分段串流並行數」只會加速切成很多小片段的串流（HLS / DASH，例如 Tw: "Concurrent fragments" only speeds up streams split into many small pieces (HLS / DASH, e.g. Twitch, niconico, live streams, m3u8 sites). Regular YouTube and Bilibili videos are single files over a single connection and aren't affected.
匯出目前的設定與 B站登入資料，或匯入到另一台電腦。: Export your settings and Bilibili login, or import them on another PC.
尚未安裝 aria2c：請先在上方 aria2c 卡片按「下載 / 更新」，安裝: aria2c isn't installed: click "Download / Update" on the aria2c card above. Until then, normal downloads are used.
目前：自動。依上面的畫質 / 編碼設定挑最好的串流；點表格裡的一列可以改成指定那: Current: Auto. Picks the best stream based on the quality / codec settings above. Click a row in the table to download that exact stream instead (only for the analyzed URL).
這是播放清單 / 合集網址，加入佇列後會下載全部；開啟「整個播放清單 / 合集」: This is a playlist / collection URL; everything in it will be downloaded. Turning on "Whole playlist / collection" also creates a subfolder named after the list.
看不懂這個範圍，請用像「1-5, 8, 10-」的寫法。: Can't understand that range. Use a format like "1-5, 8, 10-".
提示 › 已開啟多線下載，但尚未安裝 aria2c，這次改用一般下載。請到「工具: Tip › Multi-connection download is on but aria2c isn't installed, so a normal download is used this time. Install aria2c in "Tools / Settings".
找不到 qrcode 套件，請執行「pip install -r require: The qrcode package wasn't found. Run "pip install -r requirements.txt".
確定要刪除本機的 Bilibili 登入 Cookie？: Delete the Bilibili login cookies stored on this PC?
下載進行中，請等佇列結束後再更新。: Downloads are in progress. Update after the queue finishes.
另一個工具正在下載中，請稍候。: Another tool is downloading, please wait.
完成 / 失敗 / 已停止的下載都會留下紀錄，重開程式後仍可查詢。: Finished, failed and stopped downloads are all recorded and stay available after restarting the app.
已縮到系統匣，雙擊圖示可還原視窗；從選單可以結束程式。: Minimized to the system tray. Double-click the icon to restore; use its menu to exit.
還有下載進行中，確定要關閉？（未完成的檔案下次可續傳）: Downloads are still in progress. Close anyway? (Unfinished files can resume next time)
滑鼠移到這裡可複製錯誤訊息；詳細內容請看「執行紀錄」。: Hover here to copy the error message; see "Log" for details.
登入後可下載 1080P 以上；大會員可下載 4K、1080P 60 幀與 Hi: Logged-in accounts can download 1080P and above; VIP accounts get 4K, 1080P 60fps and Hi-Res audio.
Chrome / Edge 等 Chromium 瀏覽器在 Windows 上的: Chromium browsers such as Chrome / Edge encrypt their cookies on Windows, so reading them often fails and usually requires fully closing the browser first. Firefox or cookies.txt is recommended.
合併影音、轉 MP3 / FLAC、嵌入封面與字幕都需要（約 200MB 壓縮檔: Needed for merging, MP3 / FLAC conversion, and embedding thumbnails and subtitles (~200MB archive).
YouTube 需要 JavaScript 執行環境才能取得完整畫質清單。: YouTube needs a JavaScript runtime to get the full list of qualities.
多線下載用的外部下載工具（約 2.4MB）。開啟下方「多線下載」前請先安裝。: External downloader used for multi-connection downloads (~2.4MB). Install it before turning on "Multi-connection download" below.
目前未登入 Bilibili，最高只有 720P。請到「帳號 / Cookie」: Not logged in to Bilibili, so the maximum is 720P. Scan the QR code in "Accounts / Cookies" to log in.
請到「下載」頁確認存放資料夾的磁碟是否存在。: Check on the "Download" page that the drive for the save folder exists.
提示 › 尚未安裝 ffmpeg：合併影音、轉 MP3/FLAC 需要它，請到「: Tip › ffmpeg isn't installed. It's needed for merging and MP3/FLAC conversion; download it with one click in "Tools / Settings".
自動（依畫質 / 編碼設定挑最好的）: Auto (best match for the quality / codec settings)
同一個檔案開多條連線同時下載，頻寬沒跑滿時通常快很多。B站最多用 {BILI_M: Opens several connections to one file at the same time, which is usually much faster when your bandwidth isn't maxed out. Bilibili uses at most {BILI_MAX_CONNS} (too many get throttled by the CDN). Progress updates about once a second; if anything goes wrong, turn it off to return to normal downloads.
